Read as every rainbow trout at any size, this row's 'annual quota = 5' was a different statement from the zone's and both spoke; it now says exactly what the zone says, so the water's number replaces the zone's (same statement, read.effective_rules) — one limit on the page. The size is the row's own daily 'none under 50 cm'.

ONE LIMIT, READ TWICE (UI consumer's report, 2026-10-03): Region 3 (p.28) prints the same annual quota for Shuswap Lake — 'Char-Lake trout and Bull trout (Dolly Varden): 5 over 60 cm' — and the stamp (p.7) names Shuswap char as 'Lake trout and Bull trout'. Read as every char (brook trout too) at any size, this row's 'annual quota = 5' was a different statement from the zone's and both spoke; it now says exactly what the zone says, so the water's number replaces the zone's (same statement, read.effective_rules) — one limit on the page. The size is the row's own daily 'none under 60 cm'.
Anglers fishing from the community pier in Salmon Arm are exempt from this bait ban — a location-based angler exemption this schema has no field for.

entries.regs_verbatim: Region 3 Daily Quotas. Trout/char: 5, but not more than: 4 from streams, 1 over 50 cm, 1 bull trout (Dolly Varden) or lake trout, none under 60 cm. And you must release: ALL STEELHEAD, Bull trout (Dolly Varden) from streams, Aug 1-Oct 31, Lake trout from Oct 15-Jan 31.

rules.verbatim: 1 bull trout (Dolly Varden) or lake trout

rules.review_reason: User ruling 2026-10-01 (third): the wild-steelhead release binds STREAMS of the zone's own area (`feature_types: [stream]`, no `water`, so its competition key is unchanged) — 295c4ac3's reading of "lakes and streams" as every lake is reverted. A lake gets it only when its own row names steelhead.

User ruling 2026-10-02: a lake (or other non-stream water) a STEELHEAD ROW is written for or binds — by any rule of a water row that names steelhead, flags anadromous rainbow or prints the Steelhead Stamp — gets its region's zone steelhead release too (Tenas Lake, by the Atnarko/Bella Coola spring closure, gets Region 5's; Khartoum and Lois get Region 2's). The same line as trout_char_quota.r5, bound to the book-known steelhead LAKES (and wetlands) inside the zone's own area that trout_char_quota.r5 does not bind (op steelhead_waters: the reach builder's book-known set, never the curated steelhead list, within area:region:3, lakes and wetlands only — a stream piece answers to the zone it is homed in, which trout_char_quota.r5 already decides — minus trout_char_quota.r5's sections). A rule of its own because a non-area extent on trout_char_quota.r5 would rank it as a water rule on every stream it binds (`read.source_of`) and change its competition key; no `water`, as trout_char_quota.r5 has none.
